title.narrative: An Overview of the Geo-Economic Situation and Outlook in Sub-Saharan Africa facilitated by Churchill Oduor

description.narrative:
Sub-Saharan Africa is emerging as a strategically important geo-economic region, driven by demographic growth, regional integration, and expanding trade and investment opportunities. While structural constraints remain, the region’s long-term economic outlook is positive. The Netherlands is well positioned to strengthen its trade and investment engagement, particularly in sectors aligned with Dutch expertise. Strategic economic diplomacy, private sector engagement, and investment partnerships will be critical to advancing Dutch economic interests in Sub-Saharan Africa.
During the Regional Economic week, an external expert was invited to provide insights on this topic and also highlight the following:
How can the Netherlands strengthen its geo-economic position in Sub-Saharan Africa? Which sectors offer the strongest opportunities for Dutch trade and investment? How can Dutch institutional capital be mobilised more effectively? How can embassies support Dutch companies navigating African markets? How should Dutch engagement adapt to increasing global competition in Africa?
